text: Two corrections. FIRST: CONTEXT.md Established still says the workspace is cold with no sources, no claims and no code/lean, while 12 claims are filed, 20 sources are digested and two Lean files exist. Every role is being sent a brief that says the run knows nothing. Re-run the context curator and rewrite Established from derived/CLAIMS.md, including the corrected lower bounds (H(3)>=13 Li-Liu-Yang 2009, H(4)>=28 Prohens-Torregrosa 2018, Han-Li growth refinement), Bamon 1986 quadratic finiteness, and the unrefereed 2025 Yeung claim that the Dulac gap persists. SECOND: the target inventory question is answered - Roussarie-Rousseau 2015 leave exactly one graphic open, H14_3 through a triple nilpotent point at infinity, and Lu arXiv:2607.13785 (July 2026, unrefereed, 80pp) claims local uniform finite cyclicity of it and ships a reproducibility bundle with Bautin-recurrence and center-basis scripts. That bundle is now the most valuable target in this workspace: independently verify or refute its finite computational core rather than summarising it. Re-derive the Bautin recurrence and the center-basis check yourself with exact arithmetic, state the finite core as a Lean theorem and try to close it with the kernel, and report exactly which step you reproduced, which you could not, and what the paper leaves existential. Also get code/lean/Lib/Statement.lean compiling - lean_check reports failed with the sorry at line 120; a statement that does not compile is not yet a statement.

code/lean/Lib/Statement.lean compiles but does not state H16.2, and lean_check did not catch either defect. Fix both before any further Lean work. FIRST: PlanarPolyField.degree_at_most is the literal placeholder 'True', so h16_2 quantifies over every map Plane to Plane rather than over polynomial fields. Replace it with the real hypothesis - each coordinate function is in MvPolynomial (Fin 2) real with totalDegree at most n, evaluated via MvPolynomial.eval - so the binder carries the degree bound. As written the statement is not H16.2 and is false, since a smooth field can be a counterexample to it. SECOND: limitCycleCount uses Set.ncard, which is 0 for an infinite set, so a field with infinitely many limit cycles satisfies the bound trivially and the finiteness assertion - the whole content of the problem - is quantified away. State it as (LimitCycleSet f.X).Finite together with the cardinality bound, or as a Set.Finite plus ncard conjunction. Then re-run lean_check and report the verdict. Record both defects as a finding: a Lean file that compiles is not a Lean file that means the mathematics, and neither the tautology check nor the retired-binder check caught a True placeholder or an ncard-on-infinite-set hole.
